programmes.evidence: Official department overview says department has conferred doctoral degree in Management Science and Engineering since 2003 and is committed to integrated PhD/MS/BS construction; explicit research directions include SCM and reverse logistics. University business-school overview independently lists first-level discipline doctoral program in Management Science and Engineering. The official two-page 2026 doctoral intake field inventory confirms the same Management Science and Engineering doctoral programme in the School of Business and Management, with formally numbered research direction 01 运营与供应链管理 (Operations and Supply Chain Management). This establishes current provision independently of the 2021 department page.
limitations: The 2026 source is an international-applicant catalogue; it confirms current offering but does not alone exhaust any domestic-only programme/field options.
Research direction 01 is part of the single Management Science and Engineering doctorate, not a second degree.

branches.conclusion: The official business-school page names its two doctoral programmes, Management Science and Engineering and Business Administration. The full 2026 international doctoral field inventory confirms both, with formal Operations and Supply Chain Management research direction under Management Science and Engineering. No separate OM award is inferred.

The full two-page 2026 international doctoral inventory lists all current international-applicant technical degrees and numbered fields. Textile, mechanical, materials, civil/environmental, control, computing and mathematics titles/fields do not name Operations, Management Science or Industrial Engineering; manufacturing/optimization are topics within other engineering fields. Domestic-only doctoral field inventory has not been independently reconciled, so institutional engineering scope remains partial.
